HEADLINE: Trump says US won't strike Iran today, amid rising tensions

THE QUOTE — THIS IS THE ITEM
- DONALD TRUMP, President of the United States, asked by a reporter whether the US would attack Iran that day: "The answer is no. There will not be a strike today."
- Location: Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, speaking to reporters.
- Context given: tensions have been rising in US-Iran relations, and Iranian officials have confirmed preparations to target US diplomats and personnel, according to reporting by the New York Times.
